387YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: Nine territories returned senators, including Asael for Casinea and Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza for Kahraman. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Axos, the Grendel and the Sarcophan Delves, plus generals for nine armies including the Autumn Hammers and Eastern Sky. The Synod chose Dagon as Cardinal of Loyalty with 414 votes and Olyvar of Esther's Sanctum as Cardinal of Pride. The Military Council named Natalia 'The Falcon' Barossa Quartermaster General and appointed strategoi for Navarr, the Imperial Orcs, Varushka and Wintermark. Bourse seats, including the Fortress of Salt and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, went at auction, while others such as the Reeve of Boar's Market were decided by vote.

n.Dawn: Dawn's territory of Semmerholm returned Aurianna du Meravon as its senator.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: the Senate appointed Starlight Starchaser as Ambassador to the Grendel.
n.Highguard: Highguard's territory of Casinea elected Asael as its senator.
n.Imperial Orcs: Bloodcrow Ruk was appointed Strategos of the Imperial Orcs, giving the nation a new voice on the Military Council.
n.Navarr: Mouse Ddawnswraig was appointed Strategos of Navarr on the Military Council.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast returned two senators: Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza for Kahraman and Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza for Madruga.
n.The League: The League's territory of Tassato elected Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato as its senator.
n.The Marches: The Marches' territory of Upwold returned Henry Birchsmith as its senator.
n.Urizen: Urizen's territory of Morrow elected Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard as its senator.
n.Varushka: Varushka gained a new senator for Volodmartz, Ostrik Vulpe, and a new Strategos of Varushka, Grymnir "Gallows".
n.Wintermark: Wintermark returned Bronn Dunwolf as Senator for Hahnmark, and Verdehil was appointed Strategos of Wintermark.

t.Casinea: Casinea elected Asael as its senator.
t.Hahnmark: Hahnmark elected Bronn Dunwolf as its senator.
t.Kahraman: Kahraman elected Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza as its senator, with a winning bid of 10 thrones and 1 ring.
t.Madruga: Madruga elected Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza as its senator, with a winning bid of 5 thrones and 1 ring.
t.Morrow: Morrow elected Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard as its senator.
t.Semmerholm: Semmerholm elected Aurianna du Meravon as its senator.
t.Tassato: Tassato elected Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato as its senator.
t.Upwold: Upwold elected Henry Birchsmith as its senator.
t.Volodmartz: Volodmartz elected Ostrik Vulpe as its senator.

r.Casinea/Woodwych: Mentioned in passing: the new General of the Pilgrim's Defiance is named as Nathaniel of the Woodwych harts.

387YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.d: Sarangrave had been captured from the Druj during the summit and made part of Urizen by the Senate. Five armies stayed there to assault the Tower of the Skink, which Druj forces were reported to be reinforcing. Four armies moved against the Jotun in Bregasland and six struck into Skallahn towards Kierheim. Three armies each moved into Mareave and Redoubt against the Grendel. The Red Wind Corsairs pursued the Children of Wrecks from Sarvos towards Feroz. Several weary armies rested, resupplied or consolidated in Astolat, Semmerholm, Bastion, Holberg and Upwold. Many armies were enchanted, and the Quartermaster General granted a share of the guerdon to supporters of six armies.

n.Dawn: The Lions of Adelmar stayed in Sarangrave for the final push, while the Golden Sun withdrew from Therunin to defend Astolat. The Eastern Sky and Gryphon's Pride returned to Semmerholm to recover and train.
n.Druj: Having lost Sarangrave, the Druj faced five Imperial armies converging on their remaining stronghold, the Tower of the Skink, which some Druj armies had reportedly moved to reinforce.
n.Grendel: Grendel forces in Mareave faced the Seventh Wave, Winter Sun and Towerjacks. In Redoubt they faced the Pilgrim's Defiance, Black Thorns and an Argent Sword ordered to plunder their supplies and riches.
n.Highguard: The Granite Pillar advanced on the Tower of the Skink and the Pilgrim's Defiance went to defend Redoubt. The Seventh Wave attacked into Mareave, with its supporters earning a share of the guerdon, and the Valiant Pegasus joined the assault on Skallahn.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Autumn Hammers were ordered to storm the walls of Kierheim and the Summer Storm to cut down Druj overseers in Thornfen. The Winter Sun marched south to defend the orcs' lands in Mareave; supporters of both of these last two armies earned a share of the guerdon.
n.Jotun: The Jotun faced a four-army counter-attack aimed at breaking their hold on Bregasland, and six Imperial armies striking into Skallahn towards the fortress of Kierheim.
n.Navarr: With Therunin fallen under the sway of the Vallorn, the Black Thorns marched to aid Urizen in Redoubt and the Quiet Step retired to Astolat to rest and rebuild.
n.The Brass Coast: The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South joined the northern assault on Skallahn. The Red Wind Corsairs sailed from Sarvos to engage the Children of Wrecks at sea in Feroz.
n.The League: The Towerjacks advanced on Mareave to drive out the Grendel, remembering the Imperial Orcs' relief of Holberg. The Wolves of War withdrew from Therunin to resupply at Virtue's Rest in Bastion.
n.The Marches: The Bounders, Drakes and Strong Reeds launched a combined effort to free Bregasland from the Jotun, with guerdon granted to supporters of the Drakes and Strong Reeds. The Tusks billeted in Upwold to take on new troops before winter.
n.Urizen: Urizen had gained Sarangrave by Senate decision. The Argent Sword was ordered to plunder the Grendel in Redoubt, aided by Highguard and Navarr, while the Citadel Guard rested and consolidated in Semmerholm.
n.Varushka: The Boyar's Hasta and Golden Axe attacked the Tower of the Skink alongside their Axou allies, with Golden Axe supporters earning a share of the guerdon. The Northern Eagle withdrew to Holberg to resupply and train.
n.Wintermark: The Bloodcloaks went to Bregasland to recover the lost and aid the Marchers. The Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear joined the assault on Skallahn.

t.Astolat: The Golden Sun and Quiet Step arrived from Therunin and Sarangrave to mount a solid defence of Astolat and rest.
t.Bastion: The Wolves of War came to Virtue's Rest in Bastion to resupply and heal after fighting in Therunin.
t.Bay of Catazar: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel were noted to have unmatched manoeuvrability around the bay thanks to their ships.
t.Bregasland: The Bounders and Drakes launched overwhelming assaults and the Strong Reeds rose from the reeds, while the Bloodcloaks sought to recover the lost. Together they aimed to break the Jotun stranglehold on the Dour Fens.
t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: the Seventh Wave and Pilgrim's Defiance marched out of Casinea, bound for Mareave and Redoubt.
t.Feroz: The Red Wind Corsairs sailed to Feroz to challenge pirate control of the eastern islands and engage the Children of Wrecks at sea.
t.Holberg: The Northern Eagle came to Holberg to resupply and train in hit-and-run tactics. The Towerjacks also recalled the earlier siege of Holberg.
t.Liathaven: Mentioned in passing: Liathaven is not named in the orders, and no Imperial army was sent there this season.
t.Mareave: The Seventh Wave and Winter Sun made balanced attacks and the Towerjacks a steady conquest, all aimed at driving the Grendel out of land claimed by the Imperial Orcs.
t.Mitwold: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes, Bloodcloaks, Valiant Pegasus and Autumn Hammers all set out from Mitwold for Bregasland and Skallahn.
t.Mournwold: Mentioned in passing: the Mourn was described as fully Imperial again, and the Burning Falcon and Tusks departed from there.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: the Gryphon's Pride recalled its past victories in Ossium.
t.Redoubt: The Pilgrim's Defiance and Black Thorns made steady conquests to defend Redoubt against the Grendel. The Argent Sword was ordered to plunder Grendel supply lines and caches.
t.Sarangrave: Now part of Urizen, Sarangrave remained a battleground. The Lions of Adelmar, Granite Pillar, Summer Storm, Boyar's Hasta and Golden Axe moved against the Druj-held Tower of the Skink in the south.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos was declared safe, and the Red Wind Corsairs sailed from it in pursuit of the Children of Wrecks lurking off its coast.
t.Semmerholm: The Eastern Sky and Citadel Guard carried out arcane consolidation in Semmerholm and the Gryphon's Pride mounted a solid defence there while training.
t.Sermersuaq: Mentioned in passing: the Narwhal's Spear marched from Sermersuaq to Skallahn, its general addressing the territory's suffering.
t.Skallahn: Six Imperial armies drove into the heart of Skallahn towards Kierheim, domain of the late Jarl, hoping to catch the Jotun off guard while their attention was in the south.
t.Therunin: The Golden Sun and Wolves of War withdrew from Therunin, which the Black Thorns' general lamented had fallen to the sway of the Vallorn.
t.Upwold: The Tusks billeted in Upwold to take on new troops and celebrate the harvest, while the Bounders and Green Shield marched out to war.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks and Argent Sword set out from Zenith for Mareave and Redoubt.

r.Bregasland/Gravenmarch: The Bounders were ordered to make an overwhelming assault into Gravenmarch, part of a wider push from Mitwold to Gravenmarch to support the Strong Reeds against the Jotun.
r.Casinea/Woodwych: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance general is styled Nathaniel of the Woodwych harts.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky's general jokingly sent regards from the beast of Kroll.
r.Sarangrave/Thornfen: The Summer Storm was ordered to cut down Druj overseers and slave makers in Thornfen, letting freed slaves make their way to safety.
r.Skallahn/Bjarkey: The Autumn Hammers were ordered to storm the walls of the Jotun fort of Kierheim in Bjarkey.

387YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.d: The Singing Caves were allocated to the Marches and the Arch of the Sky to Urizen. Trade with Zemelslo was confirmed. The Spymaster gained the power to grant foreign access to spy networks, but not sole control over them. The Senate assigned the Sarangrave to Urizen and declared the Bloodwater Spears foreigners, but failed to do the same for the Grynbor. Membership of the Disciples of Sulemaine became punishable by death. Bids to establish the Sword Scholars and to ban the potions of the Broken Shore failed. Ambassadors were appointed to Axos, the Grendel and the Sarcophan Delves. The Throne declared war on the Brine Turtle sept, and the Ayereed smugglers' cove was decommissioned.

n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Grynbor are described as former slaves of the Druj in a failed motion to recognise them as foreigners.
n.Grendel: Starlight Starchaser was appointed Ambassador to the Grendel, and a motion to outlaw the potions of the Broken Shore, said to fund the Grendel war effort, failed. The Spymaster also decommissioned the Imperial smugglers' cove in Grendel-held Ayereed.
n.Navarr: The Voice of Barbs was made responsible for supporting the Navarr National Assembly. The Dancer's Rest in Miaren creates a Hand to the Dance appointed by that Assembly, and the First Voice Glade in Oakways is to be rebuilt to honour the Navarr bard Gerallt Brackensong.
n.Urizen: Urizen was assigned the Sarangrave and allocated the Arch of the Sky, and Urizen units driving out the Disciples of Sulemaine will not be prosecuted for their deaths. Starlight Starchaser of Urizen became Ambassador to the Grendel.
n.Wintermark: Thanmir Hrafnar of Wintermark became Ambassador to Axos. The Senate expanded the Pride of Ikka's Tears and commissioned the Forge of Bonds in Hahnmark and the Sorrowful Tunnels mithril mine in Skarsind.

t.Ayereed: The Imperial Spymaster announced the decommissioning of the smugglers' cove in Ayereed, which will take place over the season at an increased upkeep of five thrones.
t.Sarangrave: The Sarangrave was assigned to Urizen, and its senator will be elected for a shortened term at the Winter Solstice 387YE. Of its septs, the Bloodwater Spears were recognised as foreigners but the Grynbor were not.
t.Tsirku: Hahnmark proposed an appraisal of the obstacles to exploring the wastes of Tsirku, but the motion was withdrawn.

387YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Assemblies honoured the Wintermark Fist of the Mountains, who died defending Elos, and an Imperial Orc call for an Assembly of Ancestors passed with a greater majority. Urizen and Varushkan mandates against the Disciples of Sulemaine and false virtues were enacted. A Wintermark mandate invited the Jotun to Gull Island, while a writ to consecrate the Meeting Place failed. Fintan Nighthaven, Sam Wych-Elm and Yosephus Morningson were condemned. Dagon of the Shattered Tower became Cardinal of Loyalty and Olyvar of Esther's Sanctum Cardinal of Pride. The Virtue Fund made seven rewardings, and seven doses of true liao were disbursed.

n.Dawn: The Dawnish Assembly called for the recovery of artefacts stolen from the Barrens, offered friendship to the Great Forest Orcs there and to the septs who rose in Sarangrave, and warned Semmerholm's mine owners against Dho'uala. It also urged support for the Red Wind Corsairs and appointed several Dawnish posts.
n.Druj: The Druj were the target of many judgements, including a Navarr condemnation of their tortured souls, a Highborn call to study their Black Lotus, and Wintermark's call to send military units east. A Navarr highest calling to destroy them was withdrawn.
n.Grendel: Assemblies urged vigilance against two Grendel spy networks in Sarvos and against Grendel attempts to rebuild their spy network in Redoubt. Prosperity condemned trade with the Grendel on Mora's Rock, and Urizen vowed to build a navy rather than be cowed.
n.Highguard: The Highborn Assembly worked through the rift over Achseh's dedication to a false virtue with several penances and vindications. It also celebrated Ehud and Asael for funding the fourth army, Pilgrim's Defiance, and pledged its inquisitors to help the League against spies in Sarvos. Urizen awarded Highguard the benefice of the Golden Cascade.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orc Assembly's highest calling for an Assembly of Ancestors passed with a greater majority, though a call to scrap the doctrines of the Ancestors and the Howling Abyss failed. Navarr pledged to help defend Skarsind while its artisans forge a new Navarr army.
n.Jotun: Wintermark enacted a mandate inviting the Jotun to a meeting at the Gull Island hall at the Winter Solstice. A writ to consecrate the jointly rebuilt Meeting Place to Loyalty was not upheld.
n.Navarr: Navarr's sacrifice of Therunin was honoured, and the Navarr Assembly backed the Vallornguard and urged captains to rescue Thornsong House's research into a shield against vallorn miasma. It apologised to the Great Forest Orcs, but its highest calling to destroy the Druj was withdrawn.
n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn Assembly warned against the false virtue of Anarchy and called for investigation of strange occurrences at Ghita's Veil. It also urged vigilance over a threatened attack on the Azure Chorus and called for the Firebrands to be revived.
n.The League: The League declared its reckoning with Urizen complete, warned of Grendel spies and Siakha cultists in Sarvos, and praised the Great Chains of Sarvos. Its mandate restricting engagement with the Silent Manse was enacted.
n.Thule: Statements lamented the land Varushka renounced to make peace with the Thule and the magical fortress expected to follow. They vowed to give up no more ground and urged defences to be built over the next five years.
n.Urizen: An enacted Urizen mandate let its military units hunt down the Disciples of Sulemaine, and the nation honoured the Fist of the Mountains for saving Elos. Urizen also declared its reckoning with the League complete and committed to work with Navarr against the vallorn in Sarangrave.
n.Varushka: The Varushkan Assembly vowed to cede no more land to the Thule and enacted a mandate against blasphemy and heresy. It also urged the Senate to accept Oksana's offer of 900 thrones to help nationalise the Hunt of Alderei the Fair.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark mourned the Fist of the Mountains and urged its military units to go east against the Druj. It enacted mandates to invite the Jotun to Gull Island and to bring Valdr Grieversonn before the Assembly, and Kaisa Last-Lantern was condemned as an idolator of the Falconer.

t.Casinea: The Highborn Assembly called for the abandoned Greenwatch tower to be turned into a pilgrim's rest or wayfarers' house, after the Greenwatch ministry fell.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: a donation of one throne and four crowns to the Virtue Fund was made at the counting house of Karsk.
t.Redoubt: Urizen and Vigilance judgements urged the citizens of Redoubt to watch for the Grendel rebuilding their spy network. Redoubt was also named as where Sacharissa founded the Spider's Vantage Press.
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: a note recalls that tortured souls were first used during the Reikos campaign, and a donation was made at the Reikos counting house.
t.Sarangrave: Dawn invited the septs who rose against the Druj in Sarangrave to meet their Imperial neighbours. Urizen committed to work with Navarr against the vallorn there, as the Senate had assigned the territory to Urizen.
t.Segura: The Freeborn Assembly called for urgent investigation of strange occurrences at the mana site of Ghita's Veil.
t.Semmerholm: The Dawnish Assembly warned Semmerholm's mine owners not to deal with the sovereign Dho'uala or the eternal Jaheris. Vigilance also warned Dawnish mine owners of unexpected flooding in their mines.
t.Tassato: League and Navarr judgements invited Miaren's brokers to trade with the cities of Tassato to fund the war on the vallorn. The League Assembly also sought records of Tassato-born Sacharissa of Spider's Vantage.
t.The Barrens: Dawn called for the recovery of artefacts stolen in the Druj invasion and invited the Great Forest Orcs in the Barrens to work with them. A ritual had already been performed there to increase the prosperity of all inhabitants.

r.Casinea/Mareholm: The Highborn Assembly urged that the empty Greenwatch tower in Mareholm be repurposed, perhaps as a pilgrim's rest, after Ossegrahn turned away and the ministry fell.
r.Casinea/Woodwych: Mentioned in passing: the Woodwych Harts appear only in the names of priests who raised General Assembly judgements.
r.Segura/Sobral Grasses: The Freeborn Assembly called for urgent investigation of strange occurrences at Ghita's Veil, a mana site in northern Sobral Grasses.

387YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.d: Eight nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own method, while nine nations elected national titles by Tally of the Votes from 3:30pm. Friday brought an Imperial Seer scrying, Sun Chamber, Ambassador and Senate sessions and a Vallornguard strategy meeting. Saturday included a battle off Anvil, an Axou delegation to the Senate, the Bourse auction, Grandmaster elections and a midnight parley with an unknown Eternal of Winter. Sunday held another battle, the Balancing of Ephisis' Scale, Academy graduation and final Senate and Military Council sessions.

n.Dawn: Dawn elected Semmerholm's senator at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney, and at 5pm in Glory Square elected the Castellan of Spiral Castle, Reeve of Boar's Market, Merchant of the Fangs, Warden of the Weary and Envoy to the Karass; a Dawnish Fleet Captains' Meeting was also held on Saturday.
n.Highguard: Highguard elected Casinea's senator, with the inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm in the Highborn camp.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orcs elected the Legion Engineer, the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting and the Bonesetter of the Delving Market at the Fire Pit from 3:30pm.
n.Navarr: Navarr elected the Thornsinger at the Standing Circle at 4pm.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast auctioned the senatorial seats for Kahraman and Madruga from 2pm, and at 4:30pm at the Waypoint elected the Red Depths, the Mistress of the Dust Parador and the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills.
n.The League: The League elected Tassato's senator through the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm, and elected the Vardstein Vandal at the Plaza at 5pm.
n.The Marches: The Marches elected Upwold's senator when the landowners gathered at 1:30pm, and at 4:30pm in the Community Hall elected the Alder of Meade, the Master of the Root and Stem and the Stone Smith.
n.Urizen: Urizen held a demos for Morrow's senator from 1pm to 1:30pm, elected the Brilliant Star near the Net of Heaven at 3:30pm, and held a Urizen Magician's Meeting in the Hall of Worlds on Friday evening.
n.Varushka: Varushka began questioning candidates for Volodmartz's senator at 1:45pm, and at 4pm at the Central Hearth elected the Eternal Shafts of Time, the Bargainer of the Iron Tower and the Tolvoli Butcher.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark elected Hahnmark's senator with jars placed down for 15 minutes from 2pm, and at 5:30pm at the Tree of Names elected the Pride of Ikka's Tears, the Keeper of the Runegrott and the Kalpaheim Tradeholder.

t.Casinea: Casinea's senator was chosen by the Highborn, with the inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm.
t.Hahnmark: Hahnmark's senator was elected by the Wintermark jar vote, with jars placed down for 15 minutes from 2pm.
t.Kahraman: Kahraman's senatorial seat went to auction in the Brass Coast camp from 2pm.
t.Madruga: Madruga's senatorial seat was auctioned from 2pm, though its next regular election was not due until the Winter Solstice 387YE.
t.Morrow: Morrow's senator was chosen by an Urizen demos held between 1pm and 1:30pm.
t.Semmerholm: Semmerholm's senator was elected in the Dawnish camp at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.
t.Skarsind: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs elected the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting among their Tally of the Votes titles.
t.Spiral: Mentioned in passing: Dawn elected the Castellan of Spiral Castle among its national titles.
t.Tassato: Tassato's senator was elected by the League through the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm.
t.Upwold: Upwold's senator was elected when the Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm.
t.Volodmartz: Volodmartz's senator was chosen after the questioning of candidates began in the Varushkan camp at 1:45pm.

387YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: The Guerdon stayed at 150 thrones, shared among units supporting the Boyar's Hasta and Citadel Guard in Sarangrave, the Wolves of War in Therunin, and the fortification Schogsfestnir in Liathaven. Marcher and Orc units could escort the Southern Herd's cattle through Spiral to Mareave, and Freeborn units could scout southern Madruga. Fleets could trade with several foreign ports. Congregations could preach Wisdom by encouraging pilgrimage to Hacynian. Other effects included a Navarr wayhouse in Ossium, the loss of the League's gallery liao bonus in favour of a bequest to the Vallornguard, and extra rings for Highborn businesses and mines. Rivers of Life was laid on Mournwold, fortification rituals were cast on several regions, and Day-magic beacons appeared in Madruga.

n.Dawn: Dawn's 88% battle-monstering rate was singled out as below standard, and Phoenix Rising cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Hope's Rest in the Barrens.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: two Imperial armies in Druj-held Sarangrave, the Boyar's Hasta and the Citadel Guard, were named to receive shares of the Guerdon.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Mareave, partly held by Grendel, is the destination of the Southern Herd, and fortification rituals were cast on its regions of Eoradal and Icarion.
n.Highguard: A deal between Highborn benefactors and a Sarcophan sect gave every Highguard business and mine an extra 18 rings a season until the Spring Equinox 388YE. Highguard's monstering rate was 104%.
n.Imperial Orcs: Orc military units could join the escort of the Southern Herd's cattle through Spiral to Mareave, and the nation recorded a 108% monstering rate.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: Schogsfestnir in Jotun-held Liathaven was named as a fortification eligible for Guerdon shares.
n.Navarr: Navarr could take a free new resource in Ossium thanks to the Nearweald wayhouse, and could still vote as if in Therunin, where the Wolves of War received Guerdon support.
n.The Brass Coast: Freeborn units could dare the southern reaches of Madruga for vis, herbs and possibly marsh flowers. Day-magic beacons appeared on Madruga's coasts, and Serra Damata was fortified with the Frozen Citadel.
n.The League: League congregation owners lost their bonus liao from the Blood Red institutions after a seasonal bequest of ten thrones was redirected to the Vallornguard. The League's monstering rate was 104%.
n.The Marches: Marcher units could escort the cattle drive, and the Goatsbridge Coven laid Rivers of Life on Mournwold and Forge the Wooden Fastness on Alderly. The Marches' 71% monstering rate was criticised.
n.Urizen: Urizen topped the monstering rates with 111%, and the Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Proceris in Zenith.
n.Varushka: Varushka's Boyar's Hasta in Sarangrave received Guerdon support, Navarr were encouraged to settle in Varushkan Ossium, and the nation recorded a 106% monstering rate.
n.Wintermark: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh. Wintermark fleets gained a bonus trading at Caitun, but its 89% monstering rate was criticised.

t.Kahraman: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Kahraman's region of Serra Damata.
t.Kallavesa: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast on Kallavesa's region of West Marsh by the Sussivari Frost Coven.
t.Liathaven: The fortification Schogsfestnir in Liathaven was named to receive a share of the Imperial Guerdon from units defending it.
t.Madruga: Freeborn units could scout its strange southern regions after the Rod and Shield took responsibility for the Camp of the Sand Crab, and blazing Day-magic spheres appeared in all four coastal regions.
t.Mareave: The Southern Herd's cattle could reach Mareave shortly before the Autumn Equinox if escorts committed at least fifteen hundred strength. Eoradal and Icarion were also fortified with rituals.
t.Mournwold: The Goatsbridge Coven wove Rivers of Life over the Mournwold, reducing army losses, healing wounds overnight and making people, animals and plants healthy and fertile.
t.Ossium: A completed wayhouse in Nearweald let Navarr take a new resource in Ossium for free this season.
t.Sarangrave: The Boyar's Hasta and the Citadel Guard, both campaigning in Sarangrave, were named to receive shares of the Guerdon.
t.Sarvos: Congregation owners in Sarvos lost the two extra doses of liao they had received from the Blood Red institutions.
t.Spiral: The Southern Herd's cattle had to be escorted through the dangerous wilds of Spiral on the second leg of their journey to Mareave.
t.Tassato: Congregation owners in Tassato no longer received the additional two doses of liao each season after the Blood Red Bequest.
t.Temeschwar: Congregation owners in Temeschwar lost their seasonal liao bonus as patronage was redirected to the Vallornguard.
t.The Barrens: Phoenix Rising cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on the Barrens region of Hope's Rest.
t.Therunin: The Wolves of War in Therunin were named for Guerdon shares, and Navarr resettling in Ossium kept their Therunin vote in senatorial elections.
t.Zenith: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Zenith's region of Proceris.

r.Kahraman/Serra Damata: Serra Damata was enchanted with the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Voices of the Unbound Storm.
r.Kallavesa/West Marsh: West Marsh had Dripping Echoes of the Fen cast on it by the Sussivari Frost Coven.
r.Madruga/Calvos Sound: A huge, painfully bright sphere of Day-magic light appeared at the highest point beside the sea in Calvos Sound, visible for miles at night.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: A shimmering sphere of white light appeared on Free Landing's coast, plainly the result of Day magic.
r.Madruga/Lightsea: Lightsea gained one of the brilliant Day-magic spheres, shining for miles across land and sea after dark.
r.Madruga/Siroc Bayou: A blazing sphere of light appeared at Siroc Bayou's highest point by the sea, with further effects still to come.
r.Mareave/Eoradal: The Heralds of the Reaper cast the Basalt Citadel on Eoradal.
r.Mareave/Icarion: Phoenix Rising cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Icarion.
r.Mournwold/Alderly: The Goatsbridge Coven cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Alderly, alongside the Rivers of Life laid across the whole Mournwold.
r.Ossium/Nearweald: A wayhouse was completed in Nearweald, allowing Navarr to move to Ossium without the usual two crown cost.
r.The Barrens/Hope's Rest: Hope's Rest was enchanted with the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by Phoenix Rising.
r.Zenith/Proceris: Proceris had Dripping Echoes of the Fen cast on it by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: The winds covered eternal responses to plenipotentiaries, Empress Vesna's address calling for the conquest of Sarangrave, foreign diplomacy, a proposed port for Holberg, the Disciples of Sulemaine and the Falconer cult. The Free Folk pledged to strengthen the Proffered Hand. The Silent Bell lost over a hundred members spying on the Druj, and their report is due at the Winter Solstice. The Southern Herd of 272 cattle reached Nadir. Dawn and Navarr stopped Yaw'nagrah lifting Brocéliande's curse. Big Icebarn will stay in the Suaq Wastes if enough Wintermark strength supports it. Summer conjunctions destroyed the Mountain Bulwark in Bregasland and poisoned a Druj egg sac in Zenith. They also settled many smaller clashes.

n.Dawn: Dawnish units helped stop Yaw'nagrah's heralds in Brocéliande, and the Earl of the Groves invited Dawn's nobles to a banquet. The Dawnish Assembly can call on the Free Folk's aid for the Proffered Hand with a greater majority judgement.
n.Druj: The Silent Bell lost over a hundred agents spying on how the Druj wield Fear, and the Empress called for the Druj's defeat. Druj forces were beaten in several conjunctions, though the Palace of Sleepers escaped in Kroll.
n.Grendel: A Grendel surprise attack complicated the hunt for enemies in Redoubt, and the Empire had earlier penetrated a Grendel espionage outpost in Apulian. Grendel were defeated at Halkrin's Orchard, and a Grendel wind lord met the Imperial ambassador at Black Sand Tower.
n.Highguard: Highguard was tagged in winds on the Falconer cult and on Sarcophan investment. Its Champion of Pride killed servants of the Red God in Necropolis.
n.Imperial Orcs: Ten Imperial Orc warbands escorted 272 cattle of the Southern Herd safely to Nadir and had their units upgraded as a reward. The title Shepherd of the Southern Herd becomes available at the Winter Solstice.
n.Jotun: The Jotun lost the Mountain Bulwark at Cinder Drove in Bregasland and completed a fortification in West Ranging. They also featured in that season's diplomatic dealings.
n.Navarr: Navarri units joined Dawn in defeating Yaw'nagrah's heralds in Brocéliande, which prevents any attempt to lift its curse until Winter 388YE.
n.The Brass Coast: The Zemress Naval Academy has almost finished researching swift sails, and the next research project will be chosen at the Winter Solstice.
n.The League: Holberg was the focus of an appraisal into building a port and of a Commonwealth study into securing its food and water against siege and refugees.
n.The Marches: Three Marcher forces helped escort the Southern Herd and were upgraded as a reward. Ulvenwar were killed and Marcher orcs rescued in the Mournwold.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: the Thule are listed among the neighbours discussed in the Bedight in veils diplomacy wind.
n.Urizen: Urizen faces the hidden Disciples of Sulemaine. Its Field Marshal Nicassia Avicia led the poisoning of a Druj egg sac in Proceris.
n.Varushka: Delev's new Great Hall of Fabric Arts prompted a national fabric-art competition at the Winter Market. Varushkans were also tagged in the Holberg port appraisal and the mining winds.
n.Wintermark: More than twelve thousand Wintermark strength kept Big Icebarn hunting in the Suaq Wastes. Eisa Ironlungs led the destruction of the Mountain Bulwark in Bregasland.

t.Bregasland: Imperial heroes destroyed the Jotun's Mountain Bulwark and rescued the Clakes at Cinder Drove. A magician was also rescued from Picklers Marsh.
t.Brocéliande: Yaw'nagrah's attempt to lift the territory's curse was thwarted until Winter 388YE, and a cult's leaders were killed in the Darkened Glade.
t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: citizens of Casinea are tagged as interested in the Volumes of forgotten lore wind.
t.Feroz: Mentioned in passing: the new Protectorate of Morajasse is among the neighbours covered in the Bedight in veils diplomacy wind.
t.Hahnmark: A murderer was identified and escorted out of Dunfrith, and cultists were killed at Dunhall Copse.
t.Holberg: An appraisal examined building a port for Holberg, and Commonwealth scholars studied how to secure its food and water against sieges and refugees.
t.Kallavesa: All the coral husks at Mjod's Glen were destroyed.
t.Karov: Mentioned in passing: people who spent time in Karov and its mine owners are tagged in the astronomancy and magic winds.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: Karsk's mine owners are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.
t.Liathaven: Halbera Strongarm was killed, a construct was recovered and heralds of Eleonaris were slain. However, the unanswered Far Steading conjunction let the Jotun complete a fortification and Forge's Aegis was lost.
t.Madruga: Mentioned in passing: Madruga is not named on the page; the only Brass Coast item is the Zemress Naval Academy's swift sails research.
t.Mareave: The Southern Herd arrived in Nadir. The Courath of Icarion was defeated and Grendel were beaten at Halkrin's Orchard. A Grendel wind lord met the Imperial ambassador at Black Sand Tower.
t.Miaren: Imperial heroes tried to ease the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site. The outcome is unclear, though Tanwen should know more.
t.Miekarova: Cultists at the Painted Clearing were killed under the Senator for Miekarova.
t.Mournwold: A yegarra was defeated, freeing eight wains of mithril for Jonah John. Ulvenwar were killed and Marcher orcs rescued at two sites in Greensward.
t.Necropolis: Servants of the Red God were killed at Broken Grove, and the folk of Necropolis are tagged in the eternals wind.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: Ossium's mine owners and the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore are tagged in the mining and Holberg port winds.
t.Otkodov: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged in the Bedight in veils diplomacy wind.
t.Redoubt: Followers of Berechiah hunting enemies of the Empire in Redoubt were hampered by a Grendel surprise attack, but they had a stroke of luck at the last moment.
t.Sarangrave: The Empress called for Sarangrave's conquest and liberation. Vate's Shelter was recovered in Bendol, but in Kroll the Palace of Sleepers escaped and Het Trakaa lives.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm's mine owners and visitors are tagged in the eternals and astronomancy winds.
t.Sermersuaq: Big Icebarn continued hunting Agramant's monsters in the Suaq Wastes, and Typhawn was killed.
t.Skallahn: Eerikki Korpi entered the dark woods of Fareskov on behalf of the Toad King, with the outcome unclear.
t.Skarsind: Cultists in the Mormyk Woods were killed under the Shepherd of the Great Herd.
t.Spiral: Mentioned in passing: people from Spiral are tagged in the astronomancy and magic winds, and travellers from there may have seen the Southern Herd.
t.The Barrens: The manticore Earl of the Groves invited Dawn to a banquet, and Druj and heralds of Arhallogen were killed at Last Battle's Field.
t.Therunin: The Druj and heralds of Arhallogen were defeated at the Toxic Sward and the Untrod Wilds, and Eanna Glimmerwater's lantern was basked in.
t.Upwold: Mentioned in passing: people living in Upwold are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.
t.Volodmartz: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz's mine owners are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.
t.Weirwater: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater's mine owners are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.
t.Zenith: A Druj egg sac was poisoned in Proceris, although Orbubus' Weepers survive, and the Druj were defeated at Danwyn's Path.

r.Bregasland/Ottermire: The Cadet Commander's band rescued a magician from Picklers Marsh and escorted them back to Anvil.
r.Bregasland/The Rushes: At Cinder Drove, Field Marshal Eisa Ironlungs led the destruction of the Mountain Bulwark and the Clakes were rescued; Sammy Clake was executed in Anvil.
r.Brocéliande/Dark Ranging: The cult's leaders at the Darkened Glade were killed under the Speaker of the Vallornguard.
r.Brocéliande/Vale's Lament: Heralds of the Green Mother working to spread Spring magic from Vale's Lament were defeated by ten Dawnish and Navarri units.
r.Feroz/Morajasse: Mentioned in passing: the new Protectorate of Morajasse is among those discussed in the Bedight in veils wind.
r.Hahnmark/Valasmark: Cultists at Dunhall Copse were killed under the Senator for Hahnmark.
r.Hahnmark/Wood Heath: A murderer troubling Dunfrith was identified and escorted out of the village, though no trial has been reported.
r.Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh: The Crow Keeper of the Rest's band destroyed all the coral husks at Mjod's Glen.
r.Liathaven/Liath's Ring: The construct and heralds of Eleonaris at Sigryn's Bawn were killed under the Champion of Ambition.
r.Liathaven/Liaven's Glen: At Freydi's Meadow the heralds of Eleonaris were killed and the construct recovered.
r.Liathaven/West Ranging: Halbera Strongarm was killed at her stockade. The Far Steading conjunction went untaken, however: a Jotun fortification was completed, two Feni died and Forge's Aegis was lost.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: The Ambassador to the Grendel met a visiting Grendel wind lord at Black Sand Tower; the outcome is unclear, though Finna should know more.
r.Mareave/Fleisardh: Grendel were defeated at Halkrin's Orchard and their cache of resources was recovered.
r.Mareave/Icarion: The Courath of Icarion was defeated at its hold and Stormcaller was recovered.
r.Mareave/Nadir: The Southern Herd of 272 cattle arrived safely in Nadir after a two-season escort by orc and Marcher forces.
r.Miaren/Serenael: An effort to ease the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site had an unclear result.
r.Miekarova/Mieriada: Cultists at the Painted Clearing were killed.
r.Mournwold/Greensward: Ulvenwar were killed and Marcher orcs rescued at both Honour's Rest Fields and Farstrider Approach.
r.Mournwold/Southmoor: The yegarra in Warthill Woods was defeated and eight wains of mithril were delivered to Jonah John.
r.Necropolis/Coursmouth: Servants of the Red God at Broken Grove were killed under the Champion of Pride.
r.Ossium/Bittershore: Mentioned in passing: the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore is tagged in the Holberg port appraisal wind.
r.Sarangrave/Bendol: The Knight of the Greenwood's band recovered Vate's Shelter at Ghulai's Rest.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: The Palace Expanse conjunction went untaken, so the Palace of Sleepers escaped, Het Trakaa lives and the Krollthorned remain a threat.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes: Big Icebarn kept hunting Agramant's monsters and could draw out a guardian if thirteen thousand Wintermark strength supports it. Typhawn was killed at its pen.
r.Skallahn/Fareskov: Eerikki Korpi entered the Dark Woods for the Toad King, with the outcome unclear.
r.Skarsind/Estermark: Cultists in the Mormyk Woods were killed.
r.The Barrens/The Bleaks: Heralds of Arhallogen and Druj were killed at Last Battle's Field.
r.The Barrens/The Untrod Groves: The manticore calling itself Earl of the Groves, which claims Dawnish lineage, has invited Dawn to a banquet on its lands.
r.Therunin/Eastring: The Druj and heralds of Arhallogen were defeated at the Toxic Sward, and the lantern at Glimmerwater was basked in.
r.Therunin/Greenheart: The Druj were defeated in the Untrod Wilds and resources were recovered.
r.Zenith/Lustri: The Druj were defeated at Danwyn's Path under the Champion of Vigilance.
r.Zenith/Proceris: At the Plantation of Tall Ferns, Nicassia Avicia's force poisoned the Druj egg sac, though Orbubus' Weepers survive.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: Marcher armies breached Landskeeper's Bulwark and drove out the Jotun, leaving the Mournwold wholly Marcher. In Bregasland, the Strong Reeds evaded the Lion of the North while Jotun champions raided Mitwold. Eight Jotun armies shattered Schogsfestnir and retook all of Liathaven, scattering Imperial mercenaries. The Grendel were welcomed into southern Mareave by the Brine Turtles and captured Elos in Redoubt, though the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice saved the town. A second Children of Wrecks attack on Sarvos proved indecisive. Two armies held back the vallorn in Therunin, and the conquest of the Sarangrave continued. Generals were to choose two of four battle opportunities, alongside many conjunctions.

n.Dawn: Dawn's borders in the Barrens were patrolled under Ser Tunic's mandate, so the Druj needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead there. The Nobles of Dawn had a feast conjunction in the Barrens, and Dawn's Victors shared a challenge in Semmerholm.
n.Druj: The Druj were said to be in disarray as the Empire pressed its conquest of the Sarangrave, where an opportunity to claim Whisperwood was offered against them. Their unleashing of the Therunin vallorn continued to tie down two Imperial armies.
n.Grendel: The Grendel returned after months away. Their armies were welcomed into southern Mareave by the Brine Turtles sept, and an armada captured the Urizen port-city of Elos in Redoubt.
n.Highguard: Highborn armies could take the Protect the Innocent order and gained bonuses when attacking into Zenith from Morrow. A conjunction was offered to stop wreckers at Longbeach in the Necropolis.
n.Imperial Orcs: Husks rampaging in Solvihill, apparently the remains of a Temeschwar mercenary guild, fell to the Broken Shield Guardian Redhand Gezzar to defeat for a bounty of herbs. The nation had only 5 force weight available for the battles.
n.Jotun: The Jotun lost the Mournwold when Landskeeper's Bulwark fell, but eight armies smashed Schogsfestnir and retook all of Liathaven. The Lion of the North hunted the Strong Reeds in Bregasland, and Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn's warband raided Kahraman.
n.Navarr: Navarr among the mercenaries fleeing Liathaven faced summary execution by the Jotun. Navarr's 61 force weight could be committed to the summit's battles, and conjunctions were offered to the vallorn nests of Therunin and the Singing Circle in Brocéliande.
n.The Brass Coast: The families of Gambit in Kahraman were raided by a Jotun warband, and the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills was charged with killing its jarl. Red Wind corsairs fought the Children of Wrecks off Sarvos, and wreckers threatened Calvos Sound in Madruga.
n.The League: League garrisons in Sarvos fought off a second Children of Wrecks attack, which proved indecisive. The Champion of Prosperity was charged with stopping the wreckers in Riposi.
n.The Marches: The Tusks and the Burning Falcon won back the whole Mournwold, while the Strong Reeds played cat-and-eel with the Lion of the North in Bregasland. An exhibition foot-the-ball match for the Reconquest Cup was arranged near Meade to lift Marcher spirits.
n.Urizen: Urizen lost the port-city of Elos to a Grendel armada, and only the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice prevented its destruction. A battle opportunity to protect the Tower of Light and Shadow in Naris was offered, while patrols in Morrow and Zenith hindered Druj beachheads.
n.Varushka: Varushkan citizens patrolled Ossium under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate, and Varushkan armies there could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order. Varushka had 16 force weight available for the battles.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark had the largest force weight for the battles at 66, and its armies gained honour-related bonuses against the Jotun. Conjunctions in Sermersuaq targeted the Voices of Tanikipari, the Wastes and the Fount and their pillars, and Eanwyn Dunning was to bring Thurwolf to justice in Hahnmark.

t.Bregasland: The Strong Reeds evaded the Queen of Kalsea's army, the Lion of the North, in the Jotun-held marshes. A battle opportunity was offered to intervene on their behalf in the Grey Fens.
t.Brocéliande: A large, low-combat conjunction under Nathair Autumngale was offered to visit the Singing Circle in Vale's Lament.
t.Hahnmark: Thurwolf, the confessed murderer linked to the dark deeds at Dunfrith, was reported hiding in Northspires woodland amid roving bandits. Eanwyn Dunning was charged with bringing him to justice.
t.Kahraman: Jotun returned for the first time in two years when Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn's warband raided Gambit for wealth. Imperial mercenaries fleeing Liathaven scattered here.
t.Liathaven: A Jotun host of eight armies shattered the fortification of Schogsfestnir and drove every trace of Imperial presence out of the territory. Survivors, including several generals, remained trapped behind Jotun lines.
t.Madruga: Wreckers threatened Calvos Sound, and the Champion of Vigilance was charged with stopping them via a conjunction.
t.Mareave: Grendel armies marched into southern Mareave and were welcomed with open arms by the Brine Turtles sept.
t.Mitwold: Jotun champions raided into Mitwold to test its defenders. A conjunction near Meade hosted the Reconquest Cup foot-the-ball match, and the Drakes gained extra strength when fighting here.
t.Morrow: Citizen patrols under Herminius of the House of the Wanderer raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points. Highborn and Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow, or defending Morrow, gained bonuses.
t.Mournwold: Landskeeper's Bulwark was breached and the Jotun fell, leaving the Mournwold entirely in Marcher hands once more. Imperial Summer magic saved the fortification itself.
t.Necropolis: Wreckers threatened Longbeach, and the Champion of Loyalty was charged with stopping them at Abigal's Orchard.
t.Ossium: Citizen patrols under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead. Varushkan armies here could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order.
t.Redoubt: A Grendel armada captured the port-city of Elos, though the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice stopped the town being destroyed. A battle opportunity to protect the Tower of Light and Shadow in Naris was offered.
t.Sarangrave: The Imperial conquest of the territory continued against disorganised Druj. Opportunities included a battle to claim Whisperwood, conjunctions in Kroll against tortured souls and named foes, and treating the wounded in the Turan Flats.
t.Sarvos: The Children of Wrecks launched a second attack on the coast against League garrisons and Red Wind corsairs, and the fighting was indecisive. A conjunction to stop the wreckers in Riposi followed.
t.Semmerholm: The Victors of Dawn and Wintermark were invited to complete a challenge at the Grove of the Thousand in Axmure.
t.Sermersuaq: Conjunctions targeted the Voices and pillars in Tanikipari, the Suaq Wastes and the Suaq Fount. The Woundbinder of the Mark was asked to help wounded merchants in Stark.
t.Skarsind: Husks with dreadful wounds rampaged around Solvihill after screams from the Cerise Harvesters' camp. The Broken Shield Guardian was charged with defeating them.
t.Temeschwar: Mentioned in passing: the Cerise Harvesters, apparently from Temeschwar, were the mercenary guild whose camp in Solvihill gave rise to the husks.
t.The Barrens: Citizen patrols under Ser Tunic's mandate raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points. A feast at the Red Hall in Untrod Groves was offered as a conjunction.
t.Therunin: Two Imperial armies, backed by thousands of captains and adventurers, fought to hold back the vallorn the Druj had unleashed. A battle against the Ettercap Nest and several conjunctions in Sweetglades and Greenheart were offered.
t.Upwold: Imperial armies could billet in Upwold, and the Bounders gained extra strength when fighting here. Upwolders were welcome to join a side in the Reconquest Cup.
t.Zenith: Zenith shared a Wind of War with the Sarangrave, and citizen patrols raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points. Highborn and Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow gained bonuses.

r.Bregasland/Grey Fens: A battle opportunity against the Jotun at Leakey Moss was offered so that Imperial heroes could intervene for the Strong Reeds.
r.Brocéliande/Vale's Lament: Up to 600 people could visit the Singing Circle by conjunction, under Nathair Autumngale's responsibility.
r.Hahnmark/Northspires: Thurwolf was cornered by roving bandits in Greyhearth Woods, where a conjunction sought to bring him to justice.
r.Kahraman/Gambit: Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn's warband struck Gambit's families for wealth. If he were killed at Golden Copse, the Jarl of Alftanes would withdraw in grief for at least a season.
r.Liathaven/Liaven's Glen: The Jotun reclaimed Liaven's Glen and Jarl Heivar hunted Schogsfestnir's survivors. The Quartermaster General Natalia 'The Falcon' Barossa was charged with rescuing them.
r.Madruga/Calvos Sound: Wreckers at Mawrig's Point were to be stopped by a conjunction under the Champion of Vigilance.
r.Mitwold/Meade March: The New Old Sports Field outside Meade hosted the Reconquest Cup between the Eels-in-Exile and the Old Pigs, overseen by the Bailiff of the Grand Market.
r.Mournwold/Freemoor: Mentioned in passing: Freemoor is home to the Old Pigs, the foot-the-ball team playing in the Reconquest Cup.
r.Necropolis/Longbeach: The Champion of Loyalty was charged with stopping the wreckers at Abigal's Orchard.
r.Redoubt/Naris: A battle opportunity was offered on the Tilphussian Approach to protect the Tower of Light and Shadow from the Grendel and winter husks.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: Conjunctions were offered to destroy tortured souls at the Haunted Copse and to end Flavia of the Guiding Lights and Dmitriy Innokentievich.
r.Sarangrave/Turan Flats: Two low-combat conjunctions were offered to treat the wounded, at Lamorak's Rest and Ormgore's Spinney.
r.Sarangrave/Whisperwood: A battle opportunity to claim Whisperwood from the Druj at the Uklead Groves was offered for Saturday.
r.Sarvos/Riposi: The Champion of Prosperity was charged with stopping the wreckers at the Circle of Savagery.
r.Semmerholm/Axmure: A challenge at the Grove of the Thousand was offered to the Victors of Dawn and Wintermark.
r.Sermersuaq/Stark: The Woundbinder of the Mark was asked to help wounded merchants at the Iron Crossroads.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount: A conjunction at Icelveld sought to kill the Voice of the Fount and destroy its pillar, under the Speaker of the Highborn Assembly.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes: A conjunction at Wulfhere's Meadow sought to kill the Voice of the Wastes and destroy its pillar, under the Counsel of the Sun Chamber.
r.Sermersuaq/Tanikipari: Corrin Arrowsbane was charged with killing the Voice of Tanikipari and destroying its pillar on the Plains of Cyneswith.
r.Skarsind/Solvihill: Rampaging husks in the Broken Forest were to be defeated by the Broken Shield Guardian, with local coteries offering a bounty of herbs.
r.Therunin/Greenheart: The Archmage of Spring was given responsibility for a visit to the Three Stones by conjunction.
r.Therunin/Peakedge Song: A battle opportunity was offered to disrupt the Ettercap Nest in the Thorngroves against vallornspawn.
r.Therunin/Sweetglades: A vallorn nest here drew an Apothecaries' investigation and two conjunctions to disrupt it, at the Squamous Woods and the Twitching Grove.

A dark and stormy night.d: Imperial magistrates, aided by League bravos, sentinels and magicians, arrested the Grendel ringleaders in Apulian. Holdouts were executed and informants exiled, revealing operations in Sarvos, including Trivento, and in Cargo. The Vigilant found Grendel spies who had stayed behind in the closed embassy, using a secret tunnel, and paid Urizeni captains for reports. The spies were executed. Each jewel needs a Grendel navy to spend a season offshore, or Grendel control of the territory. The Senate could commission Spymaster's offices to run counter-espionage operations, or the Conclave could pursue a Shuttered Lantern grand lodge. Navarr prognosticator Eilian Sweetwater is missing, feared captured.

n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Silent Bell is described as focused on the Druj in the east, where it is suffering heavy losses, leaving it unable to hunt the remaining Grendel spies.
n.Grendel: The Grendel lost their espionage outposts in Spiral and in the old Cargo embassy, with many agents executed. Their methods were exposed: each jewel costs a navy a season offshore and a heavy purse.
n.Highguard: Necropolis was confirmed clear of Grendel espionage. Captured spies revealed that the Grendel had planned a new outpost in the Black City but lacked the resources to establish it.
n.Navarr: The Navarr Imperial Prognosticator Eilian Sweetwater vanished after sailing from Elos just before the Grendel attack on Naris. There are fears that Grendel spymasters hold him and will extract his knowledge of Imperial plans.
n.The Brass Coast: A Grendel espionage jewel was confirmed in Madruga, and one is suspected in Feroz. The Brass Coast is left with spy operations still to root out.
n.The League: League bravos raised as militia helped arrest the Grendel spies in Apulian, ending operations in Spiral. However, two Grendel jewels remain confirmed in Sarvos, including one in Trivento.
n.The Marches: Mentioned in passing: Marcher bounders in Mitwold are cited as an example of national units that could only support counter-espionage within their own nation.
n.Urizen: Grendel spies were found hiding in the old embassy in Cargo and were executed alongside Urizeni captains who had sold them information. Disgruntled Urizeni were also among those arrested in Spiral.

t.Feroz: Feroz is suspected of hosting a Grendel espionage jewel, a suspicion reinforced by Commander Gallum Fiersach's response to the Wrecker attack there.
t.Madruga: Madruga is confirmed as hosting a Grendel espionage jewel that has yet to be dealt with.
t.Mareave: Mareave is listed as clear of Grendel espionage. It is also noted as the site of the completed grand lodge of the Golden Pyramid.
t.Mitwold: Mentioned in passing: Mitwold is used as an example of where Marcher bounders could effectively support counter-espionage.
t.Necropolis: Necropolis is confirmed clear. Grendel plans for a new outpost in the Black City were never realised for lack of resources.
t.Redoubt: The followers of Berechiah uncovered Grendel spies operating from a secret tunnel in the old Cargo embassy, and magistrates arrested and executed them. Redoubt is now clear of espionage.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos is confirmed to host two Grendel espionage jewels, one of them in Trivento, despite efforts to root them out two years earlier.
t.Spiral: The Military Council shut down the Grendel outpost in Apulian through dawn raids. Holdouts were executed, informants exiled, and Grendel operations in Spiral ended.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: the former ambassador to the Grendel who ordered the embassy staff out signed himself Abel of Zenith Ascendant.

r.Redoubt/Naris: The Grendel armada swept into Naris and laid siege to Elos the day after prognosticator Eilian Sweetwater sailed from there. He has not been heard from since.
r.Sarvos/Bocche: Mentioned in passing: Bocche is not named, but the page confirms two Grendel espionage jewels in Sarvos, one of them in Trivento.

All the night-tide.d: The Delves warned the Grendel Salt Lords to stop attacking vessels trading with the Empire, and announced talks to gain a trading enclave in Beoraidh in return for backing its neutrality. They offered discounted white granite for a fortified lighthouse at Oranseri if the Senate ceded an enclave there. Highborn art sales to the Collectors sect cost the Cathedral of the Navigators prestige. The Silent Manse in Sarvos was completed. The Jakhalsmarkt opened selling partly Jarmish goods, and the House of the Buidelrat offered Moeraskriden access in exchange for two rituals. The Kruidenkenner made proposals to the Apothecaries' Guild, and Sarcophan merchants sought Hahnmark farmers about strange flowers.

n.Dawn: Ser Rosalynn Redgrave, a renowned Dawnish artist, is expected to begin decorating the completed Silent Manse, and Poortwachter Farber has written to confirm the agreement.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: their invasion and the spreading vallorn are blamed for putting Thornsong House out of action.
n.Grendel: The Sarcophan have warned the Salt Lords to stop attacking independent vessels in the Bay under the Pax Sarcophan, and their planned treaty with Beoraidh could complicate Grendel ambitions in Mareave.
n.Highguard: The art and stone deal with the Collectors raised Highborn production, but it backfired on the faith: the Cathedral of the Navigators lost prestige, and its Low Ministry and Merchant Ministry are set to decline.
n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn were offered Sarcophan white granite and DeBruin warships to help build and defend a fortified Celesti Lighthouse at Oranseri. Speaker Esmé i Estrico i Erigo's approach to the Kruidenkenner opened new herbal proposals.
n.The League: With the Silent Manse complete in Sarvos, the League Assembly urged polite disinterest, and a mandate was proposed to discourage citizens from visiting the temple.
n.The Marches: The Kruidenkenner proposed that the Apothecaries' Guild, rather than the Tally of the Votes, appoint the Master of the Root and Stem, which would gain extra herb purchases. The position would still go to a Marcher unless the Senate opened it to all citizens.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: Urizen traders' term "Triumph Vis" is cited, and its magicians are noted as having some knowledge of Jarmish star jewellery.
n.Wintermark: Sarcophan merchant Florian Kraft and vintner Renaten Zuredruiven sought to meet Hahnmark farmers at the Wintermark Tree of Names about the strange draaikolkbloem flowers.

t.Astolat: Mentioned in passing: Ser Rosalynn Redgrave, the artist hired for the Silent Manse, is from Astolat.
t.Bay of Catazar: The Pax Sarcophan is meant to protect independent shipping in the Bay from Grendel piracy, though not Imperial ships. The Delves also seek a port on the Bay at Beoraidh.
t.Feroz: The Sarcophan offered cheap white granite and naval help for a fortified Celesti Lighthouse at Oranseri in return for a trade enclave, but the lighthouse had not yet been commissioned.
t.Hahnmark: Mysterious spiral draaikolkbloem flowers keep appearing among the vlinderbloem grown for Sarcophan merchants, prompting visitors from the Delves to seek out Hahnmark's farmers.
t.Madruga: Mentioned in passing: hostile, supernaturally strengthened forces holding Free Landing make sea access to Oran difficult.
t.Mareave: A Sarcophan treaty with Beoraidh could shield the city-state and Sinfoyard from the Grendel and boost local prosperity. It would also mean either side needs four of the remaining regions to control the territory, and would limit Imperial influence in Beoraidh.
t.Mitwold: The Kruidenkenner Magazijn at Meade, overseen by the Master of the Root and Stem, would gain extra herb trade if the Apothecaries' Guild took over appointing the title.
t.Necropolis: The Kruidenkenner Magazijn at Crown's Quay would let the Kruidenkenner Trademaster buy marrowort and true vervain if the Apothecaries' Guild took over appointing the title.
t.Sarvos: The Silent Manse was completed in the Alivetti Estates, prompting League calls for disinterest. The Gold Leaf Gardeners kept trading there under Luca Beekhof.

r.Feroz/Cazar Straits: Mentioned in passing: hostile, supernaturally strengthened forces controlling the Cazar Straits make sea access to Oran challenging.
r.Feroz/Oranseri: Oranseri is the proposed site of the fortified Celesti Lighthouse citadel, where the Sarcophan want a docks enclave and offered DeBruin warships and a defensive venture and voyage.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: Mentioned in passing: Free Landing is held by hostile, supernaturally strengthened forces that hinder access by sea to Oran.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: Sarcophan is negotiating with former Salt Lord Ehsan for a trading enclave in exchange for supporting Beoraidh's neutrality. The Empire might yet influence or oppose the treaty.
r.Mareave/Sinfoyard: The Civil Service judged the proposed Sarcophan treaty would likely help protect Sinfoyard, alongside Beoraidh, from the Grendel.
r.Necropolis/Longbeach: Mentioned in passing: the page discusses the Kruidenkenner Magazijn at Crown's Quay in Necropolis, without naming Longbeach.

An iron feast.d: Only those who receive the Challenge the Iron Duke ritual may enter, and victors must wait a year before competing again. Nine covens cast the ritual the previous season. In the Eternal Banquet, challengers cook two vegetarian dishes using a secret ingredient revealed that morning, judged by Barien and chosen judges in a Summer chamber, with an extra prize for the best dish. In the Noble Hunt, held through a conjunction to Gazelle Park in Weirmoor, Weirwater, unarmed and unarmoured challengers must gather enough trophies while Jaheris' hunters pursue them with bow and spear. Death is unlikely but possible, and a second may scout for them but cannot collect trophies.

n.Dawn: Dawn is home to the Noble Hunt, held in a Summer chamber linked to Gazelle Park in the Dawnish woods of Weirmoor, and four Dawnish covens (Phoenix Rising, The Cabal of Nevezamzer, The Coven of Golden Wings and Unicorn's Glorious Charge) were among those who cast Challenge the Iron Duke last season.
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr coven The Eternal Family is listed among those who cast Challenge the Iron Duke the previous season.
n.The Brass Coast: Mentioned in passing: the Brass Coast covens The Glass Mantle and The Tempest Flame are listed among those who cast Challenge the Iron Duke the previous season.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: the Urizeni coven Ashen Flame is listed among those who cast Challenge the Iron Duke the previous season.
n.Wintermark: Mentioned in passing: the Wintermark coven Voices of the Unbound Storm is listed among those who cast Challenge the Iron Duke the previous season.

t.Weirwater: Weirwater hosts the conjunction for the Challenge of the Noble Hunt, through which challengers reach a Summer chamber linked to Gazelle Park to be pursued by Jaheris' hunters.

r.Weirwater/Weirmoor: Gazelle Park in the woods of Weirmoor is the site linked to the Iron Duke's hunting chamber, where a conjunction at 1:30pm on the Saturday carries challengers into the Noble Hunt.

Any port in a storm.d: The proposed Great Work would cost 75 white granite, 50 weirwood and 375 crowns over a year. It would raise investment in Holberg, boost taxation around the Semmerlak by 15 thrones a season, found a new town, add a ferry to Ossium and create a League Merchant-Prince post. It would also raise Varushkan dock prices by a tenth. The Lijkkever offered materials and marsh expertise in exchange for fifteen years' exclusive Sarcophan access, which would cut the tax gain to 10 thrones. The Sand Fishers offered weirwood in return for their own trade enclave. The Prognosticators' Office was short of appraisers, with Eilian Sweetwater missing in Redoubt.

n.Dawn: Mentioned in passing: past ideas to expand Lacre never emerged, and ships might sail on to Lacre if the new port were too small.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: their retreat from Holberg's outlying regions made the port feasible, and some Sand Fishers now call them 'those who take without giving'.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: a major Grendel offensive in Redoubt coincided with Eilian Sweetwater's lighthouse investigation, and he has been missing since.
n.The League: Holberg stood to gain a great port, a new town, cheaper business upgrades, wain purchases and a new League post, the Merchant-Prince of the Imperatrix Docks, if the Senate commissioned the work.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: Eilian Sweetwater vanished while investigating the destroyed Lighthouse of Nikephoros in Urizen-held Redoubt.
n.Varushka: The new port would draw trade from Korotny Docks and Kostjyas Respite, raising prices for the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore and the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak by a tenth.

t.Holberg: The Imperatrix Docks were proposed for its Utterlund coast, promising a new town, more investment, a ferry to Ossium and an extension of the Lakesedge Highway.
t.Karov: Varushka's Korotny Docks would see trade fall and the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak's prices rise by a tenth if the port were built.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: not named directly, though Varushkan ports on the Semmerlak would lose trade to the proposed docks.
t.Ossium: A ferry across the Nameless River would ease travel and trade with Holberg, though Kostjyas Respite and the Bittershore ministry would face higher prices.
t.Redoubt: Eilian Sweetwater went missing while investigating the destroyed Lighthouse of Nikephoros during a major Grendel offensive.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: the Sand Fishers modelled their request for a trade enclave on the Alivetti Enclave in Sarvos.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: earlier ideas to expand the port of Lacre never emerged.
t.The Semmerlak: The docks would boost taxation in territories bordering the lake and shift shipping away from Varushkan ports.

r.Holberg/Ennerlund: Mentioned in passing: the creeping waters of the Morass have been expanding to claim Ennerlund.
r.Holberg/Misericorde: Once the proposed port site at the end of the Lakesedge Highway, it was passed over for Utterlund, though its Sand Fishers still offered weirwood and labour.
r.Holberg/Rebeshof: Mentioned in passing: the Morass is spreading into Rebeshof, and Professor Gelberg is exploring Sand Fisher farms there.
r.Holberg/The Morass: Mentioned in passing: its expanding waters were why Misericorde was once thought the only practical port site.
r.Holberg/Utterlund: The marshy coast was the chosen site for the proposed Imperatrix Docks and the new town expected to grow around them.
r.Karov/Malimorzi: Korotny Docks would lose trade to the new port, raising the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak's prices by a tenth.
r.Ossium/Bittershore: The Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore would pay a tenth more for purchases as trade shifted to Holberg.
r.Semmerholm/Lacuve: Mentioned in passing: proposals to expand Lacre never came to anything, and ships might sail on to Lacre instead.

Because they must.d: The Tusks advanced methodically south, while the Burning Falcon, joined by Summer Knights of Glory, charged the strongest Jotun positions and smashed the defenders of the Singing Caves. The outnumbered Jotun fought hard, but Farstrider's Watch fell. The Tusks' general had ordered that none be left to contest the Marcher claim, and the garrison was wiped out. Surviving warbands are now hunted as outlaws. A Summer enchantment kept the ruined castle standing, but it will collapse unless repaired before the enchantment fades near the Summer solstice 388YE. The Singing Caves mithril mine returned to Imperial control for the Senate to allocate. Units supporting each army gained inspiration or a Summer boon.

n.Jotun: Jarl Haakon's last champions were destroyed at Farstrider's Watch, ending thirty years of Jotun domination in the Mournwold, and any surviving warbands are now hunted as outlaws.
n.The Brass Coast: The Burning Falcon marched to the aid of the Marches, smashed the defenders of the Singing Caves at the head of the assault, and earned a Summer boon for the units that fought alongside them.
n.The Marches: The Tusks kept their oath and completed the liberation of the Mournwold at little Marcher cost, earning the people's lasting trust and inspiration for those who supported them.

t.Kahraman: Mentioned in passing: the Burning Falcon's general notes they had fought on the coast in previous seasons before coming to aid the Marches.
t.Liathaven: Mentioned in passing: surviving Jotun warbands may try to escape to Liathaven, though Sarcombe and the Bounders Hall lie in their way.
t.Mournwold: The Mournwold is once again wholly Imperial and part of the Marches, with the Singing Caves mithril mine available for the Senate to allocate.

r.Mournwold/Alderly: Mentioned in passing: the green woven wards of the Prince of a Thousand Foes persisted in Alderly for another season.
r.Mournwold/Greensward: The Greensward was conquered. The Singing Caves returned to Imperial control and Farstrider's Watch was emptied of Jotun, though it stands only through a Summer enchantment and must be repaired before that fades.

Bedight in veils.d: The Otkodov treaty became law, although the formal signing was delayed until Winter. The Thule bought large quantities of food in the Marches and Navarr and took Mieriada, while leaving the Empire half the Night Quarry's output and access to the Maze of Zoria. They also asked to use the Imperial spy network in Ulnak. The Suranni clarified the status of serfs, said the curse on Kalino had lifted and planned a visit to the Marcher Wassail. The Jotun mourned Jarl Ustigar while a meeting hall rose on Gull Island, and a smidr sought help over murdered thralls. The Grendel offered Hearts Blood for black pearls. The Karass demanded the removal of the Last Battle Wayhouse, Tsark proposed low-key diplomacy, and Morajasse pledged to guard Feroz.

n.Dawn: The Karass accepted Dawnish rule of the Barrens but begged that the Last Battle Wayhouse be removed from their woods. They were also baffled by a Dawnish noble's demand for love poetry and sent three doses of true vervain instead. Finna of Dawn, Ambassador to the Grendel, received Speaker Morna's missive.
n.Druj: The Thule said they would rather the folk of the Vore did not take the Forest of Ulnak should the Druj collapse. They sought to scout Ulnak, but the Dragons will not consider helping the Empire fight the Druj without far greater rewards.
n.Grendel: The Grendel remained at war. They attacked Mareave and seized Elos in Redoubt, and claimed to have destroyed the Children of Wrecks' temple in Raineach. Their Saltbinder Grekodh offered Hearts Blood for black pearls, while Speaker Morna insisted that peace talks go only through the Ambassador to the Grendel.
n.Jotun: The Jotun honoured the fallen Jarl Ustigar of Kierheim, whose successor is unclear, and recognised Igya Olgafsdottir as their representative to the Empire. They are likely to respond to an invitation to the new Gull Island meeting hall, and a smidr planned to come to Anvil under truce over two murdered thralls.
n.Navarr: Heavy Thule food purchases reduced Navarr's ability to support armies, but the trade boom raised taxation in Hercynia and Miaren. The Karass objected strongly to Navarr scouts from the Last Battle Wayhouse, and Rak showed interest in Dylan Thornweaver's Legacy Accords.
n.The Brass Coast: The Grendel Protectorate of Morajasse pledged to guard Feroz's coast against the Children of Wrecks, many of whom had moved to islands off the Brass Coast. The Freeborn of Feroz and Segura proved suspicious of trading with the garrison, and Freeborn-linked assemblies could urge them either way.
n.The League: Mentioned in passing: Speaker Morna remarked that the Children of Wrecks seemed bent on looting Sarvos, and the Morajasse missive arrived at the Imperial Consulate in Tassato.
n.The Marches: Thule buying of herds and provisions reduced the Marches' ability to support armies, but the trade boom raised taxation in Mitwold and Upwold. A Suranni delegation planned to attend the Marcher Wassail, and the Jotun were noted as still fighting the Marchers in the south.
n.Thule: Otkodov's treaty became law, the Thule took Mieriada and laid enchantments in Ossium, and Thule warlocks joined the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun. They stalled on tariffs, warned against restricting hollows and sought access to the Ulnak spy network. They also explained what they knew of the 'face peelers'.
n.Urizen: The Grendel seized Elos in Redoubt, which was saved from destruction only by the sacrifice of the Fist of the Mountains. Tsark asked to station two sages at the abandoned Spire of the Night Sun in Zenith, and Zenith Ascendant agreed to host Sage Kristoph at Anvil.
n.Varushka: Varushka lost Mieriada, including the Night Quarry, the Painted Caves and the Tolvoli Slaughterhouse, to the Thule. The Slaughterhouse could keep operating only if a Varushkan took the reduced post of Tolvoli Butcher and kept supplying the Thule with beasts. The Thule suggested people in Ossium or Karsk might know more about the face-stealing creatures.
n.Wintermark: The Gull Island meeting hall off Kallavesa neared completion under Wintermark naval guard, and a national mandate was proposed to invite the Jotun there. The Fist of the Mountains was commended by the Grendel for its costly stand at Elos, and the scholar Marko Siwarsbairn remained a guest of the Suranni.

t.Bay of Catazar: Black pearls appeared in the bay's waters, and the Grendel said they had prepared against any threat from the depths. Saltbinder Grekodh offered a pawn of Hearts Blood for each pair of pearls.
t.Feroz: Most of Feroz had been liberated, but Grendel under Commander Gallum still held Morajasse as a recognised protectorate pledged to defend the coast against the Children of Wrecks. Local Freeborn refused to trade with the garrison.
t.Forest of Ulnak: The Thule asked to use the Imperial spy network here to map the forest and investigate magical sites, or would spy independently if refused. They would not share what they know of the Vore to the north.
t.Hercynia: Thule buying under the new treaty brought a trade boom that raised taxation here, though Navarr's ability to support armies fell.
t.Kalino: The curse that blighted the harvest in the Suranni province of Arbonne, known to the Empire as Kalino, appeared to have abated. The Suranni credited the priests of Farod, while civil servants thought it had simply run its course.
t.Kallavesa: A meeting hall for Jotun diplomacy neared completion on tidal Gull Island off Kallavesa, despite attacks by coral husks. Some locals feared the Jotun might use it as a springboard for renewed attacks.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: the Thule suggested people in Ossium or Karsk might answer questions about the face-stealing creatures once known to their human slaves.
t.Madruga: Mentioned in passing: not named directly; Speaker Morna noted that many Children of Wrecks had shifted to the islands off the Brass Coast.
t.Mareave: The Grendel launched a land offensive here, 'liberating' the Brine Turtles and threatening the mithril mine.
t.Miaren: Thule purchases under the treaty brought a trade boom that raised taxation here, though Navarr's ability to support armies fell.
t.Miekarova: A Thule army took control of the Mieriada region and its notable resources. The Empire kept half the Night Quarry's stone and conditional access to the Maze of Zoria.
t.Mitwold: Trade with Thule merchants buying food and herds brought money and higher taxation to Mitwold, at the cost of the Marches' ability to support armies.
t.Mountains of the Moon: The Council of Sages of Tsark agreed to trial restrained diplomacy with the Empire, but no Imperial citizen will be allowed to enter the Mountains.
t.Ossium: The Thule enchanted the Bonewood castle of Fljajokep and laid a ward of Night magic in the Webwood. They also confirmed that face-stealing 'face peelers' once preyed on humans in these woods.
t.Otkodov: Food, herds and supplies bought in the Marches and Navarr were shipped north to Otkodov, presumably increasing its ability to support armies. Rak insisted any remaining shortfall was well in hand.
t.Raineach: Speaker Morna said Grendel soldiers had dealt with the Temple of Tempest Jade, a Children of Wrecks fane on Raineach's shores.
t.Redoubt: A Grendel naval attack seized the port of Elos, and only the sacrifice of the Fist of the Mountains prevented its destruction and the reshaping of the coast.
t.Sarangrave: Mentioned in passing: Navarr scouts from the Last Battle Wayhouse are exploring the Nesustak Forest across the border in Sarangrave.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: Speaker Morna remarked that the Children of Wrecks seemed hell-bent on looting Sarvos.
t.Sea of Snow: Mentioned in passing: some say the terrible monsters of the Sea of Snow are why the Jotun avoid sea travel.
t.Segura: Freeborn in Lucksprings and Anozeseri, like those in Feroz, were reluctant to sell supplies to the Grendel garrison at Mora's Rock.
t.Sermersuaq: Mentioned in passing: the Thule bought meat and produce from Sermersuaq, and the old Meeting Place once lay just beyond its borders.
t.Skallahn: Jarl Ustigar was buried at Kierheim, where both claimants to Jarl of Jarls reportedly attended. A smidr of Skallahn's Skroh of the Locked Door is investigating murders he links to the Hungry Beast.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: Wind Lord Saoirse's magical missive was delivered to the Imperial Consulate in Tassato.
t.The Barrens: The Karass accepted Dawnish rule but demanded the removal of the Last Battle Wayhouse, fearing it had stirred the Manticore Earl. They offered nothing in return.
t.Tromsa: Igya Olgafsdottir, Jarl of Tromsa, was acclaimed the Jotun representative to the Empire. Tromsa is among the lands a proposed mandate would send messengers to.
t.Upwold: Trade with Thule merchants brought money and higher taxation to Upwold, at the cost of the Marches' ability to support armies.
t.Veroigne: Mentioned in passing: the Suranni ambassador's seat, Chaubrette, apparently lies to the west of Veroigne.
t.Zenith: Sage Apollion of Tsark visited Zenith to announce a trial of restrained diplomacy. He asked that two sages reside at the abandoned Spire of the Night Sun.

r.Feroz/Morajasse: Morajasse remained held from Mora's Rock by Commander Gallum Fiersach and Wind Lord Saoirse, now recognised as a foreign protectorate that Imperial generals may not attack. Saoirse offered to raise Ramparts of Ashlar over the fortress for 75 crystals of mana.
r.Feroz/Oranseri: Before the Spring Equinox, Gallum and Saoirse led their troops into Oranseri to fight the Children of Wrecks.
r.Miekarova/Mieriada: The Thule took Mieriada along with the Night Quarry, the Heart of the Tempest, the Maze of Zoria, several Painted Caves and the Tolvoli Slaughterhouse. The Night Quarry's Imperial output was halved to 14 wains.
r.Ossium/Bonewood: The Thule castle of Fljajokep in the Bonewood bore a forge-bright enchantment of brass sigils this season.
r.Ossium/Webwood: A Thule ward of Night magic seethed in the Webwood, whose border with Ulnak gives Thule scouts easy access to the Forest.
r.Otkodov/Sküld: Mentioned in passing: human labourers in the forests of Sküld once called the face-stealing creatures 'face peelers'.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: Mentioned in passing: Navarr scouts based at the Last Battle Wayhouse are exploring the Nesustak Forest.
r.Segura/Anozeseri: Folk of Anozeseri were unwilling to sell their limited supplies to the Grendel garrison at Mora's Rock.
